types.AIRD PREAMP: Amp and speaker cabinet model. The core of your tone.
types.NOISE SUPPRESSOR: Mutes hiss and hum while you are not playing.
types.GRAPHIC EQUALIZER: Boosts or cuts fixed frequency bands, one slider per band.
types.PARAMETRIC EQUALIZER: Precise EQ: pick a frequency, its width and how much to boost or cut.
types.COMPRESSOR: Evens out loud and quiet notes and adds sustain.
types.X COMPRESSOR: Studio-style compressor: evens out dynamics, adds sustain.
types.BOOSTER: Pushes the signal louder or dirtier into the next block.
types.OVERDRIVE: Mild, warm distortion like a tube amp pushed hard.
types.DISTORTION: Heavier, more saturated distortion than overdrive.
types.CHORUS: Doubles the sound with a slight wobble for width and shimmer.
types.DELAY: Repeats what you play, like an echo.
types.DELAY PLUS: Delay with extra options such as modulation and filtering.
types.ANALOG DELAY: Warm, darker echo that fades softly.
types.REVERB: Adds the sound of a room or hall around the guitar.
types.SHIMMER REVERB: Reverb with a high octave sparkle in the tail.
types.FOOT VOLUME: Volume controlled by the expression pedal.
types.OCTAVE: Adds a note one or two octaves below.
types.PITCH SHIFTER: Adds a voice shifted up or down in pitch.
types.HARMONIST: Adds a harmony that follows the key.
types.SEND/RETURN: Loop out to an external pedal and back in.
types.PHRASE LOOP: Record a phrase and play over it.
types.DIVIDER: Splits the signal into two parallel paths.
types.MIXER: Joins two parallel paths back together.

params.OFF/ON: Turns the block on or off.
params.TYPE: Which model or variation the block uses.
params.GAIN: How hard the amp is driven. Up: more distortion.
params.BASS: Low end. Up: fuller, too much: muddy.
params.MIDDLE: Mids, where the guitar sits in a mix. Up: more body.
params.PRESENCE: Upper highs and bite. Up: more cutting.
params.THRESHOLD: How quiet a signal must be before it gets muted. Up: less noise, notes fade sooner.
params.RELEASE: How fast the gate closes after you stop. Longer: more natural tails.
params.SUSTAIN: How long notes ring. Up: longer, more compressed.
params.ATTACK: How fast the effect reacts to a new note.
params.TONE: Brightness of the block. Up: brighter.
params.TIME: Time between repeats, or length of the reverb.
params.FEEDBACK: How many repeats. Up: more repeats.
params.EFFECT LEVEL: How loud the effect is next to the dry sound.
params.DIRECT LEVEL: How loud the dry, unaffected sound is.
params.PRE DELAY: Gap before the reverb starts. Up: clearer attack.
params.HIGH CUT: Removes highs from the effect. Lower: darker.
params.LOW CUT: Removes lows from the effect. Higher: thinner, cleaner.
params.MIC POSITION: Where the virtual mic points at the speaker. Centre: brighter.
params.MIC DISTANCE: How far the virtual mic sits from the speaker. Further: more room, softer attack.
params.1kHz: Mids, the core of the guitar.
params.4kHz: Presence and pick attack. Up: clearer, too much: harsh.
params.16kHz: Very top end, mostly noise on guitar.
